plugin.name: intro
plugin._long: Cinematic session-start reveal: the screen starts fully covered by a black curtain and opens onto the desktop, either as a horizontal split or as a growing iris circle. The reveal is triggered via the IPC method intro/reveal (normally by the shell once the wallpaper is visible), with a timeout as a safety net.

option.name: pattern
option._long: How the curtain opens: "split" parts it in two horizontal halves sliding off the top and bottom edges; "iris" opens a circle from the center of the screen.

option.name: duration
option._long: How long the opening animation takes.

option.name: timeout
option._long: Open the curtain on our own after this many milliseconds if nothing calls the intro/reveal IPC method, so a broken shell can never leave the session black forever.

option.name: hide_cursor
option._short: Hide the cursor during the intro
option._long: Keeps the hardware cursor from floating over the curtain. It reappears as soon as the reveal finishes.

option.name: color
option._long: Color of the curtain. Black matches the transition from the login manager.

option.name: replay
option._long: Drops the curtain again and re-opens it. Useful for tuning the options live.
